## What's new in v0.2

- **Themes** — `T` opens a theme picker with a live preview: **default**
  (the warm amber hi-fi look), **dark** (graphite, white text, cyan and pink
  accents) and **white** (paper and ink, black text, blue and orange
  accents). The choice is remembered between sessions.
- **English interface** — every label, status message, notification and
  error is now in English. The RAM readout shows `MB`.
- **Search feedback** — the results panel shows a spinner while a search or
  the launch-time recommendations are loading, instead of stale rows.
- **Homebrew** — `brew install ops-nc/tap/ytui` on macOS and Linux; the tap
  follows new releases automatically.
- Documentation in English, with the upstream project credited.
